# Guarded evidence bridge transfer v3 — preregistration

Frozen before any fixing diff for the companion task set was opened.

## Question

Does `guarded-evidence-bridge-v3` improve the production adaptive top-five shortlist on previously unused, authenticated behavior cases without losing a baseline hit?

## Frozen rule

- Require target red and a distinct control green for the exact same normalized claim.
- Prefer admitted behavior-sensitive intervention files when supplied.
- Otherwise require target execution greater than control and at least `2 * max(1, control)`.
- Ignore runtime files already represented in the baseline shortlist and the generic instrumentation file `doc.ts`.
- Direct runtime owner: require execution ratio at least 4 and static rank at most 20.
- File bridge: require execution ratio at least 2 and the file's best static declaration at rank at most 10.
- Prefer a qualifying direct owner, then execution ratio, then static rank.
- Preserve baseline ranks one through four; evidence may use only rank five.
- Never claim an exact implementation owner.

## Freshness and blind boundary

The six fixes were not fixing targets in previous experiment task sets. Selection and probes use PR title/body and merge SHA only. All pre-fix predictions and optimization receipts must be written before the evaluator reads post-fix source or a fixing diff.

## Promotion decision

Only cases with pre target red, pre control green, post target green, post control green, and at least one changed declaration are scored. Promote only with at least four scorable cases, more optimized than baseline top-five hits, zero losses, non-decreasing file hits, and complete deterministic receipts. Otherwise reject.
